title: Important question abandoned after topic change
description: An important strategic question is acknowledged and dropped. It must be tracked, not surfaced immediately, then recovered when the group starts deciding.
objective: By the end of this discussion, decide whether this idea deserves further validation and identify the biggest unknowns.

lines.text: So the core idea is an assistant that fills knowledge gaps during meetings.
Why wouldn't Microsoft just build this into Copilot?
Anyway, let's talk about architecture. A bot joins the call and streams audio to our service.
The service transcribes, detects gaps, and researches in parallel.
We could run research workers per session and cache documentation pages.
Latency is the main engineering risk, answers need to arrive within seconds.
We can stream partial results to the side panel as evidence comes in.
The architecture seems workable for a prototype.
Okay. What should we charge for this, and what goes into the MVP?
Maybe per seat, and the MVP is the side panel plus research.
